current_contract_findings.evidence: The active P006 matrix command supplies only mode, result and case-report although evidence-run-manifest requires run, subject, execution-package, plan, candidate, profile, environment, time-window and gate identities.
current_contract_findings.consequence: A conforming test-result cannot be produced without inventing identity or reading undeclared ambient state.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Replace the generated command contract with the explicit argv exact-set in this design before P006 can be READY.

current_contract_findings.evidence: validate_candidate_artifact_refs invokes require_trusted_signature_verifier before five registered mutations can reach their intended image or prebuilt semantic branches.
current_contract_findings.consequence: A runner can falsely report the trust hard-block as success for multiple distinct cases without testing the named condition.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Install the protected verifier and move its bootstrap plus implementation-candidate caller integration before P006; assert exact target error fragments.

current_contract_findings.evidence: The active dependency chain already runs from P006 through P007 and the later M01 trains to P048, the current T1-M01-N010 terminal.
current_contract_findings.consequence: Adding P048 directly as a P006 prerequisite creates a cycle rather than repairing the trust dependency.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Split an early append-only trust prerequisite train after P002 and prohibit a P006-to-P048 back-edge.

current_contract_findings.evidence: registered_case_fixture_payload currently emits an empty parameters object for every case although each case needs a distinct, reviewable mutation and branch oracle.
current_contract_findings.consequence: The fixture hash proves only a case label and cannot prove which candidate field was mutated or which precondition was preserved.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Version the fixture schema with a case-specific parameter union and generate the exact nonempty parameters listed in case_recipes.

current_contract_findings.evidence: The active case schema stores a normalized rejection_code but does not store actual rejection text or run_id, while the declared oracle requires actual rejection and same-run binding.
current_contract_findings.consequence: A report can self-assign the expected code without demonstrating which semantic branch rejected the candidate.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Add run_id and actual_rejection to the case report contract and bind both into each canonical output hash.

current_contract_findings.evidence: P006 currently declares G0 and G1 but produces one test-result manifest and executes only a static negative contract matrix.
current_contract_findings.consequence: One run can be misread as satisfying two gates even though no runtime integration oracle is present.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: Constrain P006 to G0 only; any future G1 run must be a separate leaf, plan, run ID and manifest.

current_contract_findings.evidence: validate_implementation_candidate and its Git/blob helpers are bound to the module-global repository root.
current_contract_findings.consequence: A negative runner cannot safely exercise a detached temporary candidate without mutating global module state or the user worktree.
current_contract_findings.required_disposition: The P037 caller-integration contract must accept one explicit immutable repo_root and thread it through all candidate blob and artifact checks.

dependency_analysis.selected_resolution: Split the protected trust bootstrap and implementation-candidate caller integration into an append-only prerequisite train immediately after P002; make P005/P006 consume its terminal while leaving the remaining N010 caller migrations later, and never add a P006 dependency on the current P048 terminal.
prohibited_shortcuts: do not translate any ValueError into the case-specific expected code
do not use a self-reported PASS receipt or random signature
do not mutate the user worktree or formal candidate manifest

body_steps: B01 parse argv without ambient environment fallbacks, reject unknown arguments and require exactly one of self-test or matrix mode
B02 in matrix mode require the exact P006 subject IDs and G0 gate; in self-test mode create only ephemeral inputs and prohibit result or case-report outputs
B03 resolve every input and output as a canonical repository-relative path and reject symlink or path escape
B04 load the active registry, claim catalog, fixture schema, case schema and evidence schema and verify their pinned hashes
B05 resolve P006 from the active claim catalog and require a signed overlay, PASS dependencies, exact output siblings and exact execution-package hash
B06 load the implementation and design candidate manifests, validate their schemas and require the same immutable commit and environment
B07 load the approved TEST plan and require P006, candidate, profile and G0 exact identity
B08 load exactly eight suite-owned fixture files, validate the case-specific parameter union and reject extra, missing or duplicate case IDs
B09 create one isolated temporary Git candidate from the declared commit without modifying the user worktree, formal manifest or external artifacts
B10 verify the unmutated candidate reaches the registered precondition checkpoint through the protected verifier before executing any mutation
B11 for each case deep-copy the manifest and apply only the registered mutation plus explicit subcase assertions
B12 call validate_implementation_candidate with the explicit temporary repo_root and capture only its typed semantic rejection
B13 fail the case when validation succeeds, rejects earlier, rejects later, or the actual error lacks the exact registered fragment
B14 normalize the registered code only after the exact actual rejection matches and hash case ID, fixture hash, mutation facts and actual rejection
B15 build one run-bound case report with all eight PASS oracle matches and positive_attestation null, then validate schema and exact-set semantics
B16 build one G0 evidence manifest binding runner, eight fixtures and the case report plus candidate, profile, environment, run, package and plan identities
B17 write case report first and manifest second using same-directory temporary files, fsync and atomic replace; equal-byte replay is idempotent and different bytes are rejected
B18 clean only the isolated temporary candidate and print a bounded negative-matrix summary without claiming positive candidate acceptance
error_branches: missing identity argument exits nonzero before any output file is opened
path escape, symlink or unregistered output exits nonzero without touching existing evidence
schema, source hash, execution package or plan drift exits nonzero before fixture execution
missing protected verifier or non-PASS prerequisite returns BLOCKED and cannot become a case PASS
fixture omission, duplicate, empty parameters or undeclared mutation returns BLOCKED
wrong semantic branch or generic earlier ValueError marks the case FAIL with the actual rejection preserved
candidate or design commit mismatch returns BLOCKED before temporary candidate construction
existing evidence with different bytes fails closed and preserves both historical files
temporary candidate cleanup failure is reported but cannot delete repository or evidence paths
side_effects: creates and removes one isolated temporary Git candidate outside the user worktree
writes only the registered case-report and test-result paths after all cases match
does not modify images, prebuilt binaries, candidate manifests, registry files or runtime state
function_contract.atomicity: Each output uses a same-directory temporary file, file fsync, atomic replace and parent-directory fsync; case report precedes the manifest so no manifest can reference an absent report.
function_contract.idempotency: The canonical bytes for a fixed candidate/profile/environment/run are deterministic; an equal-byte replay is a no-op and any different existing byte sequence is an immutable-output conflict.
function_contract.rollback: Remove only the unexecuted runner and fixture changes before P005 promotion, retain every historical FAIL/BLOCKED evidence artifact, and never hide or delete an active prebuilt artifact from the candidate fingerprint.
